name: eliteew-landing
description: EliteEW Landing Page - Production Build with Tailwind CSS

scripts.build:content: mkdir -p dist/content && cp src/content/landing.ru.json src/content/landing.en.json dist/content/
scripts.build:assets: cp -f logo_empery.png dist/ 2>/dev/null || true; cp -f og-landing.png og-landing-ru.png dist/ 2>/dev/null || true; for f in *.mp4; do [ -f "$f" ] && cp -f "$f" dist/; done; rm -f dist/kuku2.ru.vtt dist/kuku2.en.vtt 2>/dev/null || true; true
scripts.build:seo: mkdir -p dist/.well-known && cp src/robots.txt dist/ && cp src/.well-known/security.txt dist/.well-known/ && cp src/humans.txt src/site.webmanifest dist/
scripts.validate:content: node scripts/validate-content.mjs && node scripts/validate-plain-language.mjs && node scripts/validate-terminology.mjs && node scripts/validate-naming-policy.mjs && node scripts/validate-marketing-facts.mjs
scripts.validate:public: node scripts/validate-robots.mjs && node scripts/validate-security-txt.mjs && node scripts/validate-webmanifest.mjs && node scripts/validate-humans.mjs && node scripts/validate-security-headers-config.mjs && node scripts/validate-csp-parity.mjs && node scripts/validate-docker-build-context.mjs && node scripts/validate-nginx-gzip-config.mjs && node scripts/validate-nginx-root-location.mjs && node scripts/validate-nginx-health.mjs && node scripts/validate-app-external-links.mjs && node scripts/validate-footer-links.mjs && node scripts/validate-lang-switcher-a11y.mjs && node scripts/validate-print-styles.mjs
scripts.check:index: node scripts/check-index-shell.mjs && node scripts/validate-index-prefetch.mjs && node scripts/validate-index-meta-shell.mjs
scripts.build: npm run validate:content && npm run validate:anchors && npm run build:css && npm run build:html && npm run build:js && npm run build:content && npm run build:assets && npm run build:seo && npm run build:meta && npm run build:stamp && npm run validate:sitemap && npm run validate:meta && npm run validate:dist && npm run validate:og && npm run validate:video && npm run validate:public && npm run check:index && npm run check:budget && echo '✅ Production build complete!'
